verdict.rationale: Feitian's iePassManager and SK Manager tools are documented as letting users manage 'FIDO PIN and credential related operations' and FIDO/PIV/OTP functions, implying some credential management capability, and one product page claims 'no limit' on registered accounts. However there is no documentation showing an actual list/delete-passkey UI, no capacity figures for most key models, and no confirmation this covers standard FIDO2 discoverable-credential limits. Missing for 10: explicit list/delete-passkey walkthrough, documented credential storage capacity per model, independent verification of the 'no limit' claim.
